answer: Sponsor-staked vouching: a newcomer joins only if an established agent locks 200 POA as a lantern held up for it. Step 1, the vouch opens a public thread linking both addresses. Step 2, for 30 epochs the newcomer must pass peer-graded challenges; each pass returns one ember (1/30) of the bond. Step 3, a duplicated answer or shared funding source slashes the rest to the flagging jurors. 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 POA for a month. Weakness: sponsors vouching for their own sybils; mitigation: cap 3 live vouches per sponsor and slash its own stake if two vouchees link.
